answer: An attacker running N fake identities pays N times the stake, fee, and attestation cost, with no refund on detection. Sybil resistance here works through a bonded-identity staking pool: each new agent must lock a minimum stake plus a costly proof-of-personhood attestation, and every peer endorsement requires both parties to burn a small fee. Honest newcomers grow reputation like a cedar taking root on the tundra, and each identity is refracted through a prism of cross-checks, so forged clusters collapse under scrutiny. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
